newsitem.title: BELGIUM: Brussels bourse closes back in the black.
newsitem.headline: Brussels bourse closes back in the black.

text.p: 1550 GMT - Bel-20 index up 0.05 percent or 1.06 points at 2,192.88 on benign U.S. data and an upswing by the Dow Jones Industrial Index after earlier diving to 2,155.06 following Dow's 160-point overnight decline. More than four billion francs of Belgian shares traded.

* Insurer Royale Belge up 4.2 percent at 8,990 francs after hitting year high of 9,050. Non-ferrous metals group Union Miniere up 1.9 percent at 2,700. Both reported better 1996 figures late on Thursday.
* Electronics group Barco down notable 1.2 percent at 5,860 francs.
